cards.title: AI21 Labs finds coding benchmarks miss most developer requests
cards.summary: AI21 Labs classified 4,211 turns from seven weeks of its developers’ conversations with coding agents. Only about 11% of turns asked an agent to write code. The most common message was a clarifying question. Confirmations, redirections, git commands, and pasted context made up about 40% of turns, but appeared in almost no public coding benchmarks. AI21 Labs compared its traffic with 23 benchmarks, including SWE-bench, HumanEval, and Spider. It used the findings to build a benchmark for its intelligent gateway.
cards.reason: AI21 reports findings from developer traffic and introduces a benchmark designed around real-world coding tasks.

cards.title: Researchers introduce AesCode to generate visual designs as code
cards.summary: Xin Gao and coauthors introduced AesCode, a method that generates editable visual materials such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code. It uses an image made from the same prompt to guide the design. A design graph lets separate checks assess verifiable details and visual qualities. The researchers also built a benchmark that scores correctness and visual quality separately. Against same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines with the same reference images, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improved visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, respectively.
cards.reason: The paper attributes AesCode to tracked entity Microsoft and presents a new cross-modal reward method and benchmark.

cards.title: NVIDIA committed $250 million to UK agent safety research
cards.summary: NVIDIA committed $250 million to agent safety and security research in the UK over the next five years. An item dated October 13, 2026, states the commitment but gives no details about how NVIDIA will spend the funds. The supplied text also says NVIDIA launched an open agent safety platform on September 28, 2026. It describes the platform as a way to secure agents from testing to deployment. The text does not explain how the platform works.
cards.reason: NVIDIA announces the launch of its Open Agent Safety Platform.
